meta.name: Lost Cities Revealed with Albert Lin
meta.description: Albert Lin adventures to the ends of the earth, using advanced technology to strip back the layers of time and reveal ancient lost cities.

videos.title: Cradle of the Maya
videos.overview: Albert Lin heads deep into the Mexican jungle in search of an ancient lost city, once home to the Maya that built the great pyramid city of Palenque.

videos.title: The Warrior Kings
videos.overview: In the deserts of Sudan Albert Lin searches for the lost capital of a kingdom of Kush warriors who once conquered and ruled the mighty Egyptian empire.

videos.title: The Cloud Warriors
videos.overview: Explorer Albert Lin searches mountains of Peru to reveal the lost city of the Cloud Warriors, whose legacy was nearly wiped from history by the Incas.

videos.title: The Barbarian Kingdom
videos.overview: In remote Scotland, Albert Lin uses technology to hunt for the powerbase of the Picts, a tribe of barbarians who fought off the Roman Empire.

videos.title: Rise of the Canaanites
videos.overview: Explorer Albert Lin searches Israel for the lost world of the Canaanites, a mysterious civilization who survived a biblical climate apocalypse.

videos.title: Miracle in the Desert
videos.overview: Explorer Albert Lin and his team tackle the brutal heat of the desert and explore remote mountain caves to reveal the Legendary Land of Magan in ancient Mesopotamia.

videos.title: Secrets Beneath the Surface
videos.overview: Features Albert Lin traveling to Israel, Scotland, and Sudan in order to reveal buried secrets.

videos.title: Higher Ground
videos.overview: Features Albert Lin traveling to Peru, Oman, and Mexico in order to reveal ancient lost cities.
